The server saves the world before it is stopped.

## Server

### Added
- The host saves the world when asked, right before a stop. Write `<token> save` to `SolarpunkServer\runtime.save-request`, wait for `SolarpunkServer\runtime.save-done`, then stop the server. Without it a stop loses everything since the game's last autosave (up to 150 s). Details, and when to send `mirror` instead, in "Saving before a stop" in `docs/RUNTIME.md`.

### Changed
- The docs describe the Solarpunk 1.3.0 host: invite-code joins, one Epic identity per server, uploads, characters keyed by the player's own account, and where each log is.

Players need nothing installed: in Solarpunk choose Multiplayer, Join session, Enter Code, and type the server's 5-letter code.
